title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S34 E13 — Brunch Buffet
Ree Drummond shares ideas for a perfect brunch buffet; she packs breakfast enchiladas with chorizo and eggs, drizzles crispy potato halves in cilantro garlic sauce, makes over-the-top cinnamon crumb bagels and adds some fizz with a mimosa bar.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S37 E01 — Fresh and Simple
Ree Drummond puts a spin on recipes with her surf and turf skillet, spiced chicken sheet pan supper, mushroom and squash fajita bowls with cilantro-lime cauliflower rice and Tex-Mex toppings, and whipped cottage cheese with roasted berries.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S35 E08 — Down for Diners
The Kitchen diner dishes out ultimate comfort food classics, including Alex Guarnaschelli's indulgent Western Omelet Stuffed Peppers, Sunny Anderson's fired-up Disco Inferno Tots and Geoffrey Zakarian's flavorful Baklava Toast with Cottage Cheese.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S38 E05 — Meat and Three
"The Kitchen" hosts celebrate a Southern culinary tradition of serving meat and three sides; recipes include Classic Sweet Tea Oven Fried Chicken, Squash Casserole and Skillet Cornbread with Pepper Relish Honey Butter.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E01 — Fun With Food
"The Kitchen" is sharing fun-to-make recipes, starting with Jeff Mauro's pepperoni pizza fun-due; Katie Lee Biegel makes kid-approved beef and lentil tacos and Geoffrey Zakarian sweetens things up with almond croissant monkey bread.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E04 — A Very Retro Christmas
Five top cookie makers create Christmas cookies that reflect decades past; crafting edible snow globes with 360-degree shine while drawing flavor inspiration from globe-shaped ingredients like blood oranges, golden berries and grapes.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E07 — Tsunami Cookies
Five merry cookie makers put their sweet spin on Christmas wreaths, then, in a Christmas pull-me-up display challenge, the bakers release a tsunami of icing that completely transforms their towering displays.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S05 E02 — Self-Portraits
Five cookie-makers re-create the feel of a cup of hot cocoa on a frosty Christmas morning by crafting holiday mugs out of cookies.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S04 E01 — Holiday Throwdown: Friendsgiving Potluck
Sunny Anderson kicks off the holiday season with a Friendsgiving takedown unlike anything Bobby Flay's ever seen; chefs Damaris Phillips, Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso are serving up festive dishes with a heaping side of revenge.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S04 E04 — Holiday Throwdown: Holidays in the City
Carson Kressley brings some never-before-seen big city cheer to the holiday kitchen, enlisting hometown heavyweights Ayesha Nurdjaja, Michael Jenkins and Geoffrey Zakarian for a Big Apple showdown with Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S04 E06 — Holiday Throwdown: Christmas Eve-rywhere
Sophie Flay takes Bobby Flay on a high-stakes global holiday tour, celebrating Christmas Eve traditions from around the world; chefs Gabriele Bertaccini and Claudette Zepeda bring the heat with a holiday feast Bobby will never forget.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S02 E01 — The Holly Jolly Holiday Tournament Returns
Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.

title: Bobby Flay's the Line
description:
S01 E09 — Einat Admony: Balaboosta
Longtime competitor Einat Admony is spicing up the kitchen in a Middle Eastern matchup with Bobby Flay's home team.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E11 — Titans vs Katianna Hong
Chef Katianna Hong works her culinary magic against the Titans.

S05 E11 — Titans vs Katianna Hong
Chef Katianna Hong works her culinary magic against the Titans.

title: Worst Cooks in America
description:
S30 E03 — Reality Check: The Worst Lotus
The celebrity teams hustle during a head-to-head relay race through a faux-luxury resort to create poolside platters; then, chefs Jeff Mauro and Tiffany Derry challenge them to make crab cakes and seafood curry.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
Family Time
Esther Choi makes Gyeran-Mari, a Korean rolled omelet, and Sweet Potato Pancakes, which are huge hits with her son, Leon; then, Esther shows how to make Nurungji Chicken, a whole roasted chicken cooked over sticky rice until the skin gets crispy.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E06 — Korean Comfort Foods
Esther Choi shares some of her favorite Korean comfort foods; she makes a classic Korean rice roll, Kimbap, and takes it to the next level with a simple Ramyun; then, she pairs Seafood Japchae with Spinach Namul to keep things fresh and balanced.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E01 — Kimchi Time
Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi, a fast Mak Kimchi that's ready in just days, as well as Halmoni's Kimchi, her grandmother's recipe; plus, Esther shares how to make Kimchi Fried Rice and bossam, Korean Pork Belly Wraps.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E02 — Late Night Bites
Esther Choi shares some Korean street food classics, starting with extra crispy Korean Fried Chicken with Pickled Yuja Daikon; she also shows how to make Tteokbokki, chewy rice cakes simmered in a spicy sauce, and Gimmari, crispy seaweed rolls.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E03 — Korean Burger Time
Choi makes her popular Korean Burger recipe with a side of Broccoli with Crumbled Tofu. Then, Esther rounds out the meal with Hotteok, a crispy doughnut with a gooey apple center that can be enjoyed on its own or with a Gochujang Caramel sauce.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S37 E11 — For the Table
Everyone's digging into Sunny Anderson's Smoked Gouda Skillet Mac and Cheese, Jeff Mauro's Ultimate Sausage Board, Geoffrey Zakarian's Blistered Shishito Peppers and Katie Lee Biegel's Loaded Fried Deviled Eggs.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E04 — The Kitchen's Tool-torials
The hosts show how to use kitchen tools to make recipes like Sesame Ginger Chicken and Rice Bowls, Mushroom Toast with Herbed Goat Cheese, and Slow Cooker Brownies; Ayesha Nurdjaja makes Tunisian Egg Salad using a wire cooling rack.

title: Kids Baking Championship
description:
Light Up the Holidays
Four fan favorite kid competitors return for a new holiday challenge: making a holiday candle tsunami cake with a poured sugar flame; host Duff Goldman is joined by Abby Martin to offer her unique perspective as a former contestant.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S01 E07 — Crafty Christmas
Five bakers take on a stringy trend and build Christmas cookie carousels.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E07 — Wacky Christmas
Five merry cookie makers must create edible Christmas comic strips; the bakers create larger-than-life cookie ornaments that must incorporate some extra-small ingredients.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E05 — Our Better Angels
Five cookie makers reveal who's on Santa's list by creating cookies showing someone doing a good deed and another being naughty; competitors create a display of cookie angel figurines filled with good spirits.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E06 — Christmas Then and Now
Ree and Eddie challenge five cookie makers to make holiday cookies from when dinosaurs roamed the Earth; the bakers craft 3D vehicles fueled with soda flavors for moving around the North Pole.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S06 E04 — Christmas Roots
Five crafty cookie makers design their own interpretation of a young Santa and Mrs. Claus; cookie greenhouses with edible windows and herbs.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E01 — Welcome to Santa's Workshop
Host Jesse Palmer divides the 12 bakers into two teams and challenges them to make holiday stained-glass cakes; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh decide the winner of a $1,000 prize package and one baker from losing team is eliminated.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E02 — The Time of Your Life
After a peppermint dessert preheat, Jesse Palmer asks the baking teams to make radical red velvet desserts in honor of Santa's fresh fit; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh choose the winner of the $1,000 prize package.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E01 — Memorable Firsts and Magic
James and Oliver challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:

title: Kids Baking Championship
description:
North Pole Edition
Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli lead eight talented young bakers through tasty challenges designed to find the most impressive and creative baker.

title: Kitchen Undercover
description:
S01 E02 — Broke Spirits
A struggling brewery must reinvigorate recipes for a shot at redemption.

title: Kitchen Undercover
description:
S01 E03 — The San Pedro Sting
The San Pedro Brewing Company is struggling after a sudden drop in sales; Chef Antonia Lofaso sends her sous-chef Nestor Milian to uncover the chaos with hidden cameras before she uses her skill to bring this restaurant back to its former glory.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S03 E10 — Alex vs California
California-based chefs aim to take down New Yorker Alex Guarnaschelli with their coastal cuisine; the chefs bet their skills with Californian food can win over judges Michael Voltaggio and Troy Johnson and give them a chance at defeating chef Alex.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S03 E09 — Alex vs Potatoes
Eric Adjepong welcomes three spud experts from across the country to challenge Alex Guarnaschelli with one of America's top foods; judges Simon Majumdar and Ricardo Zarate determine if one of these chefs can beat chef Alex in her own kitchen.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S03 E05 — Alex vs Salmon
Eric Adjepong welcomes three of the country's most skilled salmon experts to prove their knowledge of fish can compete with Alex Guarnaschelli's experience; the ingredients they choose could give them an advantage or help Alex.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S03 E07 — Alex vs Pastry
Eric Adjepong welcomes three pastry chefs from Kentucky, California and New Jersey to outshine Alex Guarnaschelli's pastry expertise; the chefs pull out all the stops for judges Sherry Yard and Stephanie Boswell to give Alex a run for her money.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E08 — Leftovers Gone Wild!
In the appetizer round, the chefs show that they have what it takes to transform leftovers into a meal; in the entrée round, the competitors attempt to impress the judges using a variety of tools and techniques.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E01 — Military Salute: Navy
U.S. Navy chefs will have to create spectacular appetizers using an aged meat product before reworking a patriotic cake for dessert, all with $75,000 for a charitable cause on the line.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E02 — Military Salute: Air Force
Four members of the U.S. Air Force compete; in the appetizer basket, the chefs find a bowl of something comforting and a crunchy snack, while the dessert round includes a wild play on pickles.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E03 — Military Salute: Marines
Chopped welcomes the U.S. Marine Corps chefs to the kitchen; the competitors must figure out how to make something that's normally ready-to-eat ready for the judges and get creative when a breakfast food appears in the basket.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E04 — Military Salute: Army
Four chefs from the U.S. Army transform a favorite soldier comfort food into an elevated appetizer; a festive drink shakes up the competitors in the dessert round as they fight for a spot in the tournament's finale.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E05 — Military Salute: Finale
The four military finalists cook as a team against a mystery "Chopped" judge in every round; their teamwork and creativity will be tested as they battle against star chefs for the chance to win $75,000 for a charitable cause.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S37 E01 — Chopped Takedown
Alex Guarnaschelli and Marc Murphy band together with chefs Daniel Le and Michael Michaelis to teach Bobby Flay a thing or two about lobster.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S40 E04 — Arrivederci, Bobby!
Jeff Mauro and comedian Chelsea Peretti bring Bobby Flay the laughs as they cheer on Italian chefs Antonio de Ieso and Ciro Fodera.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S40 E07 — This Is How We Roll
Bobby Flay is way out of his element with a signature dish he's never made before; Damaris Phillips and Christian Petroni taunt him as chefs Ilji Cheung and Pyet Despain attempt to roll up a win.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E08 — Today's Forecast: Defeat
Bobby Flay meets his match when meteorologist Ginger Zee and Sunny Anderson storm the kitchen with chefs Basil Yu and Sanjay Rawat.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E12 — Titans vs. An Iron Chef
An OG Iron Chef is ready to show Bobby Flay's Titans who's boss; it's not this contender's first time in the TT kitchen, but this time, he brings his knives; Bobby's good friend and industry veteran Stephen Kalt decides who will be victorious.

title: Bobby Flay's the Line
description:
S01 E10 — Dale Talde: Goosefeather
Time is not on their side when the clock gets the best of the chefs in a Cantonese cook-off between Bobby Flay's home team and Dale Talde's visiting line.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E05 — Just Another Flay in The Office
Chef Christian Petroni and actress Kate Flannery from "The Office" recruit chefs Josh Gale and Christian Ortiz for a hostile takeover of Bobby Flay's kitchen.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E09 — Bottoms Up, Bobby Down!
Actress, comedian and foodie Aisha Tyler and Katie Lee Biegel get crafty.

title: The Kitchen: World on a Plate
description: We make delicious bites inspired by countries all over the world.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S19 E03 — Friendsgiving Favorites
Special guests Ted Allen, Christian Petroni and Martina McBride join the group for a Friendsgiving filled with Turkey Day favorites; sweet-and-spicy smoked turkey and smoked gravy; triple sec cranberry relish; fried Brussels sprouts.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E08 — Fall Festival Favorites
The kitchen is making their favorite fall festival treats, including the ultimate pumpkin bread, honey-fried turkey legs with Japanese BBQ sauce and apple fritters with hot honey glaze; a game of Try or Deny features some unexpected fall flavors!

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E09 — Titans vs. Ashleigh Shanti
Bobby Flay invites rising star Chef Ashleigh Shanti to face-off against the Titans; she keeps the Titans guessing with her unique mix of Appalachian and Southern cooking, while Chef Wylie Dufresne doles out his criticisms.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E08 — Titans vs. Katsuji Tanabe
Chef Katsuji Tanabe's bravado is as big as his desire to take down Bobby Flay's Titans; Katsuji is desperate for his first big win, and it's up to judge Judy Joo to decide if it's his turn for victory.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E07 — Titans vs. Kaleena Bliss
Chef Kaleena Bliss is on a competition winning streak; chef Kaleena is beaten Bobby Flay, and now he's invited her to try her luck at the Titans, while Bobby's protégé, Chef Hillary Sterling, dishes out tough critiques.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E10 — Titans vs. Michael Jenkins
The Titans think they're ready to go up against Alex Guarnaschelli's protégé, Chef Michael Jenkins; Michael has judged each of the Titans before and uses that knowledge to his advantage.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E02 — Best Noodles Ever
Guy Fieri sends chefs running down aisles in this high-stakes competition.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E04 — Red, White, and Food
Guy Fieri invites three GGG winners to celebrate America's 250th birthday with a cook-off. First, the chefs make a picnic plate with ingredients like apple pie and corn dogs. Then, a game of cornhole determines the ingredients for a grilled dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S19 E10 — GGG Winners' Holiday Extravaganza
Four previous winners return for the holidays to take on more of Guy Fieri's games; chefs must shop for ingredients using nothing but oversized stockings; chefs are given a gingerbread house that they must flip into a fine dining holiday dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S28 E08 — Fieri Family Holiday Showdown
Guy Fieri's two sons and nephew face off; Guy pairs each family member with their very own all-star chef partner, but he also gives each team a Secret Santa box full of weird ingredients to use.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S35 E06 — GGG Best Buddies Holiday Special
Guy Fieri teams up some of his friends from the Best Buddies volunteer organization with some all-star chefs for a holiday cook-off; the teams have one hour to make a holiday entrée and dessert for a chance to earn $15,000 for their teammate.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E01 — Memorable Firsts and Magic
James and Oliver challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E02 — The Chamber Challenge
James and Oliver ask the baking teams to bring the Basilisk, Moaning Myrtle, a Howler and Hermione as a cat to life in their cakes; the showpieces are presented to judges Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain in the iconic Chamber of Secrets itself.

description:
S13 E02 — The Time of Your Life
